Name: NAIRR Pilot
Eligibility: US academics, nonprofits, agencies, startups w/ federal grants
Amount: Compute + data, not cash
Deadline: Rolling; open until resources are exhausted
Notes: Requirement: Project results must be open and shared with the community. PI name, affiliation, title, and abstract are posted publicly

Name: NVIDIA Inception
Eligibility: Startups only
Amount: GPU credits, technical access

Name: Claude for Startups (Anthropic)
Eligibility: Startups (eligibility N/A in the newsletter)
Amount: Free Claude API credits plus priority rate limits (no dollar value stated)

Name: Microsoft for Startups Founders Hub
Eligibility: Startups; no equity or VC introduction required
Amount: Up to ~$150K in Azure credits plus AI model access and dev tools

Name: AWS Activate
Eligibility: Early-stage startups
Amount: $1K-$100K in AWS credits, valid for two years

Name: ElevenLabs Startup Grants
Eligibility: Startups (eligibility N/A)
Amount: 33M free voice-AI credits (~$10K value) for 12 months

Name: Google for Startups Cloud Program
Eligibility: Early-stage startups (tier by funding stage)
Amount: Google Cloud credits; amount N/A in email (public info: up to ~$200K, more for AI startups; verify)
Notes: Source: inbound email from Google Cloud Startups SDR. Amount and URL not in email, verify on site

Name: Cloudflare for Startups
Eligibility: For-profit startups incorporated within 10 yrs, funded up to Series B, first-time applicants. Bootstrapped teams (under $1M raised) get the $10K tier
Amount: $10K (bootstrapped), $100K (under $5M raised, partner-funded), up to $350K (over $5M raised, partner-funded) in Cloudflare credits, valid 1 yr
Notes: Credits, not cash. Review takes up to 48 hrs. Agencies, consultancies, and personal blogs do not fit. Cloudflare blog says top tier is $250K, the page says $350K. Source: web search + sponsor page, Nov 2026. Verify on site

Name: Databricks for Startups
Eligibility: Early-stage, venture-backed startups (pre-seed to Series A preferred). No public criteria. An investor can nominate
Amount: Up to $200K in credits for Databricks and Neon (Postgres)
Notes: Credits, not cash. Credit duration not stated. The AI Accelerator Program is separate and invitation-only. Source: web search + sponsor page, Nov 2026. Verify on site

Name: Together AI Startup Accelerator
Eligibility: Pre-seed to growth-stage AI startups. Selection-based. Tier set by funding raised
Amount: Up to $15K (raised under $5M), $30K ($5-10M), $50K (over $10M) in platform credits, plus 3/6/10 hrs of forward-deployed engineering
Notes: Credits, not cash. Credits cover serverless inference, dedicated endpoints, fine-tuning, and instant clusters. They do not cover Reserved GPU Clusters. Credit validity not stated. Source: Together AI page, Nov 2026

Name: Modal for Startups
Eligibility: Early-stage startups new to Modal. A payment method is required
Amount: Up to $50K in GPU cloud credits (Modal page). A directory says up to $25K
Notes: Credits, not cash. Amount differs by source: verify. Source: web search + sponsor page, Nov 2026. Verify on site

Name: DigitalOcean Hatch
Eligibility: AI-native startups that raised $10M or less. Apply through a partner (accelerator or VC). No earlier DigitalOcean credits. Service agencies excluded
Amount: Credits set per startup by the partner, valid 12 months, $10K monthly use limit. GPU credits are a separate review
Deadline: Paused: applications for the current cohort are closed. Updated program launches early 2027
Notes: Credits exclude GPU Droplets, Serverless Inference, and third-party AI models. Unused credits are forfeited. Source: DigitalOcean page, Nov 2026

Name: MongoDB for Startups
Eligibility: Startups 7 yrs old or younger, Series B or earlier, building one software product (no agencies). Needs a website and LinkedIn page
Amount: Up to $15K in MongoDB Atlas credits, by stage and partner
Notes: Credits, not cash. Decision by email in about 5 business days. Activate the promo code within 30 days. Credits valid 12 months (6 months for $500). Source: MongoDB page, Nov 2026

Name: Nebius Research Grants
Eligibility: PhD students, postdocs, faculty, and researchers at accredited academic or nonprofit institutions. Apply once per team
Amount: GPU cloud credits, Token Factory tokens, and Tavily credits. Amount set per proposal
Deadline: Rolling; open year-round. Proposals done by month end enter the next review cycle
Notes: Credits, not cash. Winners agree to co-marketing. Credits are released after onboarding and identity checks. Source: Nebius page, Nov 2026

Name: Google Cloud Research Credits
Eligibility: Faculty, PhD students, and postdocs at accredited higher-ed or eligible nonprofit research institutions in listed countries
Amount: Amount not on the page. Third-party sources say ~$5K for faculty and postdocs, ~$1K for PhD students
Notes: Credits, not cash. Form needs a proposal of up to 250 words, a pricing calculator estimate, and a Google Cloud Billing Account ID. Activate within 60 days. Credits expire after 365 days. Amount is unverified: check on site

Name: AWS Cloud Credit for Research
Eligibility: Full-time faculty, research staff, and grad or PhD students at accredited research institutions. Institutional email required
Amount: AWS promotional credits: students up to $5K, no stated cap for faculty and staff. Valid 1 yr, no extension
Notes: Credits, not cash. Funds finite projects only (proof of concept, repeatable solution, workshop). EC2 limited to on-demand and spot. Applications from greater China are not processed. Contact: aws-research-credit@amazon.com. Different from Amazon Research Awards in the Grants tab. Source: AWS page via web search, Nov 2026

Name: NVIDIA Academic Grant Program
Eligibility: Full-time faculty at accredited institutions that award PhDs. Worldwide. Project must use NVIDIA pretrained models or software
Amount: Up to 30,000 NVIDIA H100 80GB GPU hours, or hardware (up to 8 RTX PRO 6000 GPUs, or 2 DGX Spark systems), by call for proposals
Deadline: Not accepting applications now. No reopening date stated
Notes: Compute, not cash. Also gives letters of support and a GTC presentation slot. Past recipients must report results to apply again. Join the NVIDIA Developer Program for updates. Source: NVIDIA page, Nov 2026

Name: Anthropic AI for Science Program
Eligibility: Researchers at academic or nonprofit institutions on high-priority scientific projects, mostly biology and life sciences. Biosecurity screening applies
Amount: Up to $20K in Claude API credits for 6 months
Deadline: Rolling; evaluated on the first Monday of each month
Notes: Credits, not cash. API only, not the Claude web app. No fine-tuning or nonpublic models. A multi-person group applies once. Unselected applicants get no reply. Source: Anthropic help center, Nov 2026

Name: Anthropic External Researcher Access Program
Eligibility: Researchers on AI safety and alignment topics that Anthropic sees as high priority. Must be in a country where Claude is available
Amount: $1K in Claude API credits (more in rare cases)
Deadline: Rolling; evaluated on the first Monday of each month
Notes: Credits, not cash. API only, not the Claude web app. No fine-tuning or nonpublic models. Credits go to one org ID that the team splits. Unselected applicants get no reply. Source: Anthropic help center, Nov 2026

Name: NSF ACCESS Allocations
Eligibility: Researchers and educators with an ACCESS ID. No NSF award needed. Grad students need an advisor letter for Explore and Discover
Amount: Free compute allocations in ACCESS credits: Explore up to 400K, Discover up to 1.5M, Accelerate 3M, Maximize no set cap
Deadline: Rolling for Explore, Discover, and Accelerate. Maximize has semi-annual windows
Notes: Compute, not cash: GPU, large-memory, and storage systems. Explore and Discover get an eligibility check only. Accelerate and Maximize get panel merit review. Start with Explore. Related: NAIRR Pilot in this tab. Source: ACCESS pages via web search, Nov 2026
